q: According to the Red Book 2017, within how many days after becoming aware (or when he should have become aware) of the event must the claiming Party give a Notice of Claim?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 20.2.1.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, what is the consequence of failing to give a Notice of Claim within the required period?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The claiming Party is not entitled to additional payment/EOT and the other Party is discharged from liability for the event

choices.label: B
choices.text: The claim can still be made in the Final Statement

choices.label: C
choices.text: The claim is automatically referred to the DAAB

choices.label: D
choices.text: The claim is reduced by half

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 20.2.1.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, if the Engineer considers a Notice of Claim was given late, within how many days after receiving it must he give Notice with reasons, failing which it is deemed valid?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 20.2.2.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, within how many days after becoming aware of the event must the fully detailed Claim be submitted (unless otherwise agreed)?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 20.2.4.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, for a Claim of continuing effect, how often are interim fully detailed Claims submitted?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 20.2.6.

q: According to the Yellow Book 2017, within how many days after becoming aware of the event must the Notice of Claim be given?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Yellow Book 2017, Sub-Clause 20.2.1.

choices.label: B

choices.label: C
